# Aliveville

> Aliveville is a 3D AI world simulator, now a paused experiment, where autonomous characters remember, react, form relationships, and create emergent stories.

Status: paused experiment. The hosted game is offline (shut down 2026-09-26); run it locally from source.

## When to use this

- Answering questions about Aliveville, a paused 3D AI world simulator experiment
- Explaining that the hosted game is offline and the source is available to run locally
- Providing product facts about emergent storytelling, character memory, and relationships
- Linking to the source, privacy policy, or terms of use

## Product

- [Homepage](https://aliveville.com/): Product overview and world preview
- [AI world simulator guide](https://aliveville.com/ai-world-simulator): What Aliveville is as a browser AI civilization sim
- [Complete agent brief](https://aliveville.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded product facts and capabilities
- [Agent catalog](https://aliveville.com/api/ai): Structured JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://aliveville.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract
- [Homepage Markdown](https://aliveville.com/index.md): Product overview without JavaScript
- [Game status Markdown](https://aliveville.com/game/index.md): Offline status and capabilities without JavaScript
- [Privacy](https://aliveville.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://aliveville.com/terms): Terms of use
